name: Alysia Barnes
story: Alysia Barnes of the Ministry for Primary Industries presented the use of Survey123 for monitoring kauri dieback at the 2017 New Zealand Esri User Conference. The case is a named example of mobile forms, location capture and conservation biosecurity being combined in a field workflow.
